---
title: "NCAA Tournament Overperformance — Logistic Regression"
author: "Cole Rajaratnam"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: pdf_document
---

```{r}
data <- read_project_data <- function() {
  candidates <- c("data/kenpom_tournament_data.csv", "../data/kenpom_tournament_data.csv")
  paths <- candidates[file.exists(candidates)]
  if (length(paths) == 0) {
    stop("Missing KenPom data: see data/README.md for instructions.")
  }
  read.csv(paths[1], check.names = TRUE)
}
data <- read_project_data()
```

```{r}
avg_wins_by_seed <- aggregate(Wins.0.6. ~ Seed, data = data, mean)
avg_wins_by_seed
```

```{r}
data <- merge(data, avg_wins_by_seed, by = "Seed", suffixes = c("", "_avg"))
```

```{r}
data$outperform <- ifelse(data$Wins.0.6. > data$Wins.0.6._avg, 1, 0)
```

```{r}
table(data$outperform)
```
```{r}
model1 <- glm(outperform ~ AdjOE, data = data, family = binomial)
summary(model1)
```
```{r}
model2 <- glm(outperform ~ AdjDE, data = data, family = binomial)
summary(model2)
```
```{r}
model3 <- glm(outperform ~ AdjOE + AdjDE, data = data, family = binomial)
summary(model3)
```
```{r}
model4 <- glm(outperform ~ AdjOE + AdjDE + Seed, data = data, family = binomial)
summary(model4)
```

```{r}
model5 <- glm(outperform ~ RankAdjOE + RankAdjDE + Seed, data = data, family = binomial)
summary(model5)
```
```{r}
exp(coef(model5))
```
```{r}
x_def <- sort(data$RankAdjDE)
y_def <- fitted(model5)[order(data$RankAdjDE)]
smooth_def <- lowess(x_def, y_def)

plot(smooth_def,
     type = "l",
     lwd = 3,
     col = "blue",
     xlab = "Defensive Efficiency Rank",
     ylab = "Probability of Outperforming",
     main = "Effect of Defensive Efficiency on Outperforming",
     ylim = c(0, 1))
```

```{r}
x <- sort(data$RankAdjOE)
y <- fitted(model5)[order(data$RankAdjOE)]
smooth <- lowess(x, y)

plot(smooth,
     type = "l",
     lwd = 3,
     col = "blue",
     xlab = "Offensive Efficiency Rank",
     ylab = "Probability of Outperforming",
     main = "Effect of Offensive Efficiency on Outperforming",
     ylim = c(0, 1))
```
